notes: Encoded ONLY from FTXL's own page. No era floors, styles, or tables imported from any related page (no Cadet eras, no Crest/Copper-Fin/EnergyRite content), even though the pages look alike. The page states these serial styles were utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems, but no per-brand reuse is claimed here and no usesStylesOf is set. SHIPPED styles are those whose year (and month/week, where shipped) is stated in retrievable page text; month letters are chart-only, so styles 3-6 ship YEAR-ONLY per precedent. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both chart-only), page Style 7 (5Y013 & 6S1064 & 11AA0365: year letters chart-only, so no year can be encoded even though month positions are numeric). SHIPPED FROM THIS PAGE ONLY, NOT IMPORTED: page Style 9 (85041234: year 1st & 2nd digits, month 3rd & 4th digits, 8-digit serials, 1984 to present) ships because it is stated on THIS page; it is absent from the 2017 Crest/Copper-Fin pages and is not carried over from them. Page Style 5 ships in its SINGLE page form only (J93-1030F, 8 characters normalized); the 9-character detail form found on the Crest page is NOT encoded here because it does not appear on this page. Page Style 8 order is explicit on this page (year = 7th & 8th digits, month = 9th & 10th digits), so no sentence-order inference is needed. See report for image-pass items.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page notes this style used from 2011 to present.
Year = 1st & 2nd digits = '93' (normalized positions [1,3]). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. Page notes this style used from 1978 to present.
Year = 1st & 2nd digits = '07' (normalized positions [1,3]). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. Page notes this style used from 1978 to present.

styles.era: 8-character serials, letter + digits + letter, year only (single page form)
styles.notes: Year = 1st & 2nd digits = '93' (normalized positions [1,3]). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. ONLY the page's own form is encoded (list and section both show J 93-1030F); the 9-character detail form on the Crest page is deliberately not carried over. Page notes this style used with Standard Hi-Power and Oil Fired BRE Series models from 1974 to 1997.
Year = 1st & 2nd digits = '78' (normalized positions [1,3]). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. Page notes this style used with HF, G-O and PG series from 1965 through 1986.

styles.era: 10-digit serials, last four digits are year + month
styles.notes: Page states year = 7th & 8th digits and month = 9th & 10th digits explicitly (1-based), converted to [6,8] and [8,10]. Page notes this style used with Electric Boosters (SB) series from 1978 through 2010, always 10 digits.

Page states year = 1st & 2nd digits and month = 3rd & 4th digits explicitly (1-based), converted to [0,2] and [2,4]. Example is the page's own '85 041234' with the space stripped by normalization. Page notes this style used with HF, G-O and PG series from 1984 to present, always 8 digits. This style ships from this page's own text; it is not imported from any other Lochinvar page.
